description: These files are UTF-8, comma-separated, with a POINT as the decimal separator and ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). In Excel do not double-click them: use Data > From Text/CSV, set File Origin to 65001: Unicode (UTF-8), Delimiter to Comma and Locale to English (United States), then Load. Double-clicking on a Dutch Windows uses a semicolon and a decimal comma, which puts every row in one column and turns 1.5 into 15. In Power BI use Get Data > Text/CSV with the same three settings; it will detect them correctly on its own in most cases.
Primary key. One record is one delivery at one store.
Delivery date. Deliveries run six days a week, Monday to Saturday.
Foreign key to sites.site_id. Where this delivery departed from. A store receives a regional (fresh, morning) and a central (ambient and frozen, afternoon) delivery on the same day.
Foreign key to stores.store_id.
Route this stop belongs to. Several stops share one route_id.
Position of this stop within the route, starting at 1.
Foreign key to vehicles.vehicle_id.
Driver identifier, DRV001-DRV065. Not a separate master table.

Total cases delivered on this stop.

End of the agreed delivery window.

Recorded arrival time from the board computer.
Kilometres attributed to this stop. The leg from the previous location plus a proportional share of the drive back to the DC, so the stops of a route add up to the whole route.

Unloading time recorded at the store.
Fuel or energy attributed to this stop, consistent with distance_leg_km. Unit in energy_unit.
l for diesel vehicles, kWh for electric ones.
Trip cost attributed to this stop: driver time, vehicle kilometres, a fixed stop charge and a share of planning overhead.
